structured_parsing_instructions:

If a single line or sentence in the source text describes multiple, distinct, non-contiguous observation periods (e.g., by listing different event dates or referencing a table with multiple dates), you MUST create a separate DataCollectionPeriod object for EACH distinct period.
Do NOT group multiple distinct dates into a single time_range string.
